application question

**Why are you interested in this position?**

I am interested because this role sits where deep technical work meets real intelligence impact. CrowdStrike's Counter Adversary Operations team tracks nation state adversaries and turns technical findings into finished intelligence that gives customers a decision advantage. That is the kind of work I want to do. My MSc in Information Security at Royal Holloway gave me a foundation in security management, cryptography, secure business architectures, digital forensics and network security, and my projects let me test that in practice. I built InboxDefender, a Python phishing-analysis tool that maps indicators to MITRE ATT&CK, and AttackSurfaceIQ, a Python tool that analyses Windows Event Logs to identify endpoint risks. I also hold CompTIA Security+ and ISC2 CC. What draws me most is the combination of reverse engineering, malware analysis and reporting for readers at every level. I want to be someone who can take a technical finding and make it useful to the people responding to it.

**Relevant experience:**

- Certifications: CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), IBM Ethical Hacking with Kali Linux, Deloitte and Mastercard cyber security job simulations via Forage.
- Coding languages: Python, PowerShell, SQL, JavaScript, Java, C, C++, MySQL.
- Coursework: MSc Information Security, Royal Holloway — cryptography, security management, critical infrastructure security, secure business architectures, digital forensics, network security. BCA, MIT World Peace University — Python, Java, JavaScript, C++, C, MySQL, AI and ML, Angular, mobile application development.
- Projects: InboxDefender (Python phishing analysis with MITRE ATT&CK mapping), AttackSurfaceIQ (Windows Event Log analysis), SafePaste (Chrome extension detecting sensitive data in pasted content).
- Work experience: IT Support Assistant at The Colourful Aura — first point of contact for 15 employees across 15–20 devices, Active Directory access management, suspicious email investigation, technical documentation. Person in Charge at The Co-operative Group — weekly risk assessments, incident documentation, corrective action follow-up, coordinating 7–8 colleagues per shift.
